description: Department of Fiscal Policy - The Bilateral Agreement for Prevention of Fiscal Evasion entered into on 06.10.2016, between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Finland
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of a bilateral agreement between Sri Lanka and Finland for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion. It is a formal legal/regulatory instrument (a tax treaty) that has been approved by Parliament and is being notified under the Inland Revenue Act. This fits the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for "New laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "International agreements and treaties."
